author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After examining several props and miniatures in the Academy Museum's Debbie Reynolds Conservation Studio, Adam is drawn to the cabinets and drawers housing the supplies used for painstaking conservation projects. From favorite adhesives to custom-made sanding sticks, here's a tour of the tools that conservators use to clean and restore museum objects. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/
The Last Surviving Spaceship from 2001: A Space Odyssey: https://youtu.be/nDHNmhsTh0A
